steps.title: Craft the table
steps.say: Craft an enchanting table from 1 book, 2 diamonds and 4 obsidian, set out like the picture. You need a diamond pickaxe or better to mine obsidian.

steps.title: Make 15 bookshelves
steps.say: For the best enchantments you need 15 bookshelves. Each one takes 6 wood planks and 3 books, and a book is 3 paper and 1 leather.

steps.title: Place the bookshelves
steps.say: Place the table with 15 bookshelves around it like the picture, with 1 empty block between them. Even a torch in that gap stops a bookshelf from working.

steps.title: Mine lapis lazuli
steps.say: Mine lapis lazuli ore with a stone pickaxe or better. Each one drops 4 to 9 lapis, and it's most common near Y 0.

steps.title: Earn experience levels
steps.say: Earn levels by defeating monsters, mining ores like coal or diamond, and smelting. The best enchantments need level 30.

steps.title: Put in your item
steps.say: Use the enchanting table and put in something that isn't enchanted yet, like a sword, pickaxe, armor or a book. Then add 3 lapis lazuli.

steps.title: Pick the bottom choice
steps.say: With all 15 bookshelves, the bottom choice needs level 30 but only uses up 3 levels and 3 lapis. It usually gives the best enchantments.

steps.title: Get your gear ready
steps.say: This is a big, tough fight. Bring armor, a sword, a bow, lots of arrows, food and blocks. Never sleep in a bed in the End, because it explodes.

steps.title: Make eyes of ender
steps.say: Craft each eye of ender from 1 blaze powder and 1 ender pearl. Make at least 12, plus a few spares, because some eyes break when you throw them.

steps.title: Find the stronghold
steps.say: Throw an eye of ender and follow it. Pick it up if it drops. When it flies down instead of up, dig down to find the stronghold.

steps.title: Open the End portal
steps.say: Place an eye in every empty portal frame. When all 12 have eyes, the portal opens. Jump in, then stay away from the edges and don't look at endermen.

steps.title: Break the crystals
steps.say: Shoot the crystals on the towers first, because they heal the dragon. For the 2 in cages, build up, break some bars, then shoot from a few blocks away.

steps.title: Fight the dragon
steps.say: Shoot the dragon with arrows while it flies. When it lands on the portal in the middle, hit it with your sword. Stay out of its breath and purple clouds.

steps.title: Collect the egg
steps.say: Hit the egg once and it jumps to the ground nearby. Put a torch 2 blocks under it, then break the block it sits on, so it drops for you.

steps.title: Go home
steps.say: When the dragon is beaten, the portal in the middle turns on. Jump in to go home. You'll come back at your bed, or where you first started.

steps.title: Pack for the trip
steps.say: Bring an iron pickaxe or better, a spare pickaxe, food, torches and a water bucket. A weaker pickaxe breaks diamond ore but gives you nothing.

steps.title: Turn on coordinates
steps.say: In your world settings, turn on Show Coordinates. The middle number is Y, and it tells you how high or deep you are.

steps.title: Dig down safely
steps.say: Dig down like a staircase, never straight under your feet. Digging straight down can drop you into a cave or into lava.

steps.title: Stop at minus 53
steps.say: Stop when Y says minus 53. Diamonds are common there, and the lava that fills the deepest caves stays below your feet.

steps.title: Watch for lava
steps.say: Lava can still show up down here. Pour water from your bucket onto it to turn it into obsidian or cobblestone.

steps.title: Dig long tunnels
steps.say: Dig a long, flat tunnel 2 blocks high and 1 block wide. Place torches as you go so you can see and fewer monsters spawn.

steps.title: Avoid the sculk
steps.say: If your tunnel opens into a cave covered in sculk, turn back and dig somewhere else. Sculk shriekers there can call the Warden, a very strong monster.

steps.title: Mine the diamonds
steps.say: When you find diamond ore, mine the blocks around it first so no diamond can fall into lava. Each ore gives 1 diamond.

title: Build a Nether portal
askedAs: how to get to the nether

steps.title: Get 10 obsidian
steps.say: You need 10 obsidian. Mine it with a diamond or netherite pickaxe, because a weaker pickaxe gets you nothing.

steps.title: Make flint and steel
steps.say: Craft flint and steel from 1 iron ingot and 1 flint. Mining gravel sometimes drops flint.

steps.title: Build the frame
steps.say: Stand 10 obsidian up like a big door, as in the picture. The hole inside is 2 blocks wide and 3 tall, and corners can be any block or empty.

steps.title: Light it
steps.say: Use your flint and steel on the inside of the frame. A purple swirl fills the door when it works.

steps.title: Pack for the Nether
steps.say: Keep your flint and steel with you. In the Nether, water from a bucket vanishes, and a bed explodes if you try to sleep in it.

steps.title: Step inside
steps.say: Stand inside the portal and wait about 4 seconds. You'll come out of a portal in the Nether, and that portal is your way home.

steps.title: Remember your portal
steps.say: Before you explore, check your coordinates next to the portal and write them down. That way you can find it again.

steps.title: Light it again
steps.say: If a ghast's fireball blows out your portal, use your flint and steel on the frame to light it again. Then step in to go home.

steps.title: Make an iron door
steps.say: At a crafting table, craft 6 iron ingots into 3 iron doors. Iron doors won't open by hand. They need power from something like a button.

steps.title: Make a stone button
steps.say: Craft a stone button from 1 stone. To get stone, smelt cobblestone in a furnace.

steps.title: Make a pressure plate
steps.say: Craft a stone pressure plate from 2 stone. This one goes inside, so you can open the door on your way out.

steps.title: Make a doorway
steps.say: Use a wall of solid blocks like planks or stone. Make a hole in it 1 block wide and 2 blocks tall, starting at the ground.

steps.title: Place the iron door
steps.say: Stand outside and place the iron door in the hole. Try to open it by hand. It won't open yet, and that's okay.

steps.title: Add the button outside
steps.say: Outside, place the button on the wall block right next to the bottom of the door. Use the button, and the door opens, then closes by itself a second later.

steps.title: Add the plate inside
steps.say: Inside, place the pressure plate on the floor right in front of the door. Step on it to walk out. Keep it inside, because monsters can step on plates too.

steps.title: Try a lever instead
steps.say: Want the door to stay open? Craft a lever from 1 stick and 1 cobblestone and put it beside the door. Flip it to open, flip again to close.

steps.title: Gather your wood
steps.say: Find a flat, grassy spot near trees, and start in the daytime. Chop about 30 logs and craft them into planks. Each log makes 4 planks.

steps.title: Lay the floor
steps.say: Place planks on the ground in a square, 5 blocks long and 5 blocks wide. That's 25 planks.

steps.title: Place the door
steps.say: Craft 6 planks into 3 doors at a crafting table. Stand outside and place 1 door on the middle block of the front edge of the floor.

steps.title: Build the walls
steps.say: Build walls 3 high on the edge of the floor, up to the door. Leave a hole on each side of the door's top half for windows. That's 44 planks.

steps.title: Add the windows
steps.say: Smelt 2 sand in a furnace to make 2 glass. Place 1 glass in each window hole.

steps.title: Put on the roof
steps.say: Cover the top with a flat roof of planks, 5 by 5, using 25 planks. A roof stops spiders from climbing in over the walls.

steps.title: Light it up
steps.say: Craft torches from coal and sticks. Put 1 on an inside wall, 1 on the roof and a few on the ground outside. Light helps stop monsters from appearing.

steps.title: Place your bed
steps.say: Craft a bed from 3 wool of the same color and 3 planks. Place it by the back wall. Sleep in it at night, and you'll respawn here.

steps.title: Get raw fish
steps.say: Get a few raw cod or raw salmon. Fishing with a fishing rod is a great way to catch them. Keep the fish raw, not cooked.

steps.title: Find a stray cat
steps.say: Look for stray cats in villages. They like to wander, so check around the houses and nearby.

steps.title: Hold the fish
steps.say: Cats are shy and run from people. Hold the fish, stand still, and let the cat slowly walk up to you.

steps.title: Feed it fish
steps.say: When the cat is close, feed it the fish 1 at a time. It can take a few tries.

steps.title: Look for the collar
steps.say: Smoke means not yet, so keep feeding. Hearts and a red collar mean the cat is yours, and it won't run from you anymore!

steps.title: Make it sit
steps.say: Use your empty hand on your cat to make it sit. Do it again and it gets up and follows you.

steps.title: Heal your cat
steps.say: If your cat gets hurt, feed it raw cod or raw salmon to heal it.

steps.title: See what cats do
steps.say: Creepers stay away from cats, so your cat helps keep you safe. It might sleep on your bed and leave you a gift in the morning.

steps.title: Get some bones
steps.say: Skeletons often drop bones when you defeat them. Collect several, because a wolf can take a few bones to tame.

steps.title: Find a wolf
steps.say: Look for wolves in forests and spruce forests, even snowy ones. Never hit a wolf, or its whole pack gets angry and can't be tamed.

steps.title: Feed it bones
steps.say: Hold a bone near the wolf and it tilts its head at you. Feed it bones 1 at a time.

steps.title: Look for the collar
steps.say: Smoke means not yet, so keep feeding. Hearts and a red collar mean your wolf is tamed!

steps.title: Make it sit
steps.say: Use your empty hand on your wolf to make it sit and stay. Do it again and it stands up and follows you.

steps.title: Take it along
steps.say: A standing wolf follows you around. If you get too far away, it can teleport to catch up with you.

steps.title: Heal your wolf
steps.say: If its tail hangs low, your wolf is hurt. Feed it meat like steak or cooked chicken to heal it. Even rotten flesh works.

steps.title: Color its collar
steps.say: Want a new look? Use any dye on your wolf to change its collar color.

steps.title: Make a hoe
steps.say: Make a wooden hoe at a crafting table with 2 planks and 2 sticks. A stone or iron hoe works too.

steps.title: Collect wheat seeds
steps.say: Break grass to find wheat seeds. Only some grass drops a seed, so keep going until you have a handful.

steps.title: Add the water
steps.say: Pick a flat grassy spot and dig 1 hole in the middle. Fill a bucket at a lake or river and pour the water in.

steps.title: Hoe the ground
steps.say: Use your hoe on the ground all around the water to make farmland. Water keeps farmland wet up to 4 blocks away in every direction.

steps.title: Plant the seeds
steps.say: Place 1 seed on each farmland block. Walk on your farm but never jump, because jumping on farmland turns it back into dirt.

steps.title: Protect your farm
steps.say: Build a fence with a gate around your farm to keep mobs from trampling it. Put torches on the fence posts so monsters don't spawn nearby.

steps.title: Speed it up
steps.say: Wheat takes time to grow. Use bone meal on a wheat plant to help it grow faster. You can make bone meal from a bone.

steps.title: Harvest and replant
steps.say: When the wheat turns brown, break it to get wheat and usually some seeds. Plant seeds back in each spot. 3 wheat make 1 bread!
